policy.purpose: Discover fresh local-news candidates from primary institutional sources without using an LLM.
policy.date_provenance_rule: Automatic sources must expose a trustworthy article-level publication date. LOCAL NEWS OS resolves structured article metadata > article-scoped date after H1 > unique page date; ambiguous dates are rejected fail-closed.

sources.disable_reason: The official Berbești Știri archive is indexed with stable municipal story titles and per-item dates, but a fresh direct fetch of the official archive is intercepted by an anti-bot verification page. LOCAL NEWS OS requires deterministic canonical-page access and article-level publication provenance before automatic admission; search-engine cache or listing metadata must not substitute for a verifiable article fetch. The source is retained for territorial coverage and manual discovery but disabled until direct article retrieval is deterministic.

sources.disable_reason: The official DSP Vâlcea site remains a high-value primary health source, but its current homepage and legacy Joomla health/press streams do not consistently expose trustworthy article-level publication metadata for current campaigns and notices. The live discovery ledger observed 3 candidate links with 2 article failures. Automatic freshness in LOCAL NEWS OS requires explicit article publication metadata, so this source is retained in the Vâlcea SOURCE_PACK but disabled from automatic admission until a deterministic publication timestamp can be proven.
safe_use: primary-source verification of public-health campaigns and notices
manual reporting after explicit publication-date verification
sources.core_feedback: Reinforces the generic ARTICLE_FEED structural-eligibility requirement: source reachability must be distinct from publication-timestamp capability, and persistent high article-failure/no-date patterns should surface a source-contract incompatibility signal. No DSP/Vâlcea-specific parser should be added.

sources.disable_reason: The official Noutăți page is structurally reachable and article-dated, but its current editorial output is dominated by RUNOS recruitment and exam/competition notices. The existing Vâlcea path hints explicitly admit /anunturi/ and examene-si-concursuri URLs, so a newly posted vacancy could be projected automatically as a SĂNĂTATE news item even though it is staffing administration rather than reader-facing health news. Automatic admission is disabled until the hospital exposes a separable patient-care/service/investment stream or the source can be constrained deterministically without importing recruitment notices.
safe_use: manual discovery of hospital staffing and service developments
primary-source verification of medical-service or patient-information changes
manual reporting on hospital investment or service capacity when independently newsworthy
sources.core_feedback: No new CORE parser or Vâlcea-specific classifier is justified for this source. Topical fit and source selection are VALCEA_SPECIFIC configuration concerns. The existing generic item-level content-class/safety direction may eventually support mixed feeds, but until then this feed should fail closed rather than turn recruitment notices into health news.

sources.disable_reason: The official Voineasa announcements stream remains a high-value primary source for DN 7A, Obârșia Lotrului water/sewerage and environmental notices, but it is structurally a dated document/PDF listing rather than a reliable HTML article feed. The current live discovery ledger recorded 12 links examined with 4 article failures, and fresh direct browsing is intermittently intercepted by an anti-bot verification page. LOCAL NEWS OS must not promote a listing date, PDF filename or document-internal date to article published_at, so automatic admission is disabled until canonical item retrieval and publication provenance are deterministic.
safe_use: manual discovery of Voineasa infrastructure and environmental notices
primary-source verification of attached official PDFs and affected geography
manual reporting only after separating listing date, document date and event or decision date
sources.core_feedback: No Voineasa-specific parser is justified. This reinforces the existing ARTICLE_FEED versus DOCUMENT_REGISTER/PDF_FEED boundary and the requirement to keep structural eligibility separate from network or WAF health; persistent article failures should surface contract incompatibility, but transient fetch errors alone must not rewrite editorial semantics.
